description: This file defines a mock class for the IMediaPipelineService interface used in testing media pipeline functionalities within the Rialto server service. It includes mock method declarations for various media control operations and manages dependencies on external media pipeline components.

classes.name: MediaPipelineServiceMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IMediaPipelineService interface for unit testing media pipeline interactions.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Mocks the creation of a media session with specified parameters.

methods.name: destroySession
methods.description: Mocks the destruction of a media session identified by an integer ID.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Mocks loading media with specified type and source strings.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Mocks attaching a media source to a session.

methods.name: removeSource
methods.description: Mocks removing a media source from a session.

methods.name: allSourcesAttached
methods.description: Mocks checking if all sources are attached for a session.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Mocks starting playback for a session.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Mocks pausing playback for a session.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Mocks stopping playback for a session.

methods.name: setPlaybackRate
methods.description: Mocks setting the playback rate for a session.

methods.name: setPosition
methods.description: Mocks setting the playback position for a session.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the current playback position for a session.

methods.name: setVideoWindow
methods.description: Mocks setting the video window parameters for a session.

methods.name: haveData
methods.description: Mocks checking if data is available for a session.

methods.name: renderFrame
methods.description: Mocks rendering a frame for a session.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Mocks setting the volume for a session.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the volume level for a session.

methods.name: setMute
methods.description: Mocks muting or unmuting a session.

methods.name: getMute
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the mute status for a session.

methods.name: getSupportedMimeTypes
methods.description: Mocks retrieving supported MIME types for a media source type.

methods.name: isMimeTypeSupported
methods.description: Mocks checking if a MIME type is supported.
